verdict.rationale: Zapier's API reference docs say each public API (Actions, Connections, Trigger Inbox) has an interactive playground where you pick an endpoint, fill in parameters and run live requests from the browser via a "Try it" console. The reference is backed by published OpenAPI 3.1 specs and an API catalog; the probe's 404s at default openapi paths don't contradict this, since specs are served at /api-reference/specs/. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground working, and evidence of copyable code samples beyond the in-browser runner.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Each API in the sidebar includes an interactive playground where you can make live requests. Select an endpoint, fill in the parameters, and run it directly from the browser
